items.description:
Spec-Savers Polokwane Savannah is an optometry and audiology store in Shop 31/32 at Savannah Mall, on the corner of Grimm and Thabo Mbeki Street in Fauna Park, Polokwane. It is part of the national Spec-Savers chain and offers eye tests, prescription spectacles, sunglasses and gift cards. Customers can also book a hearing test at the store.

The store says it combines professional standards with quality eyewear at affordable prices, and it offers lens enhancements along with guides to lens types, face shapes and sizing. A Try 6 For Free offer lets shoppers test a selection of frames before buying. The branch suits shoppers at Savannah Mall who want an eye test and a new pair of glasses in one visit.

Standard Bank Seshego Circle trades as Standard Bank's Seshego Cashless Branch, inside Seshego Circle shopping centre at 1 Ditlou Street in Seshego. Rather than a typical full-service branch built around an over-the-counter cash facility, it runs on a cashless banking model, focused on card, digital and account-based services for everyday banking.

The branch gives Standard Bank customers in Seshego a local point of contact for account queries, applications and day-to-day transactions, without needing to travel further into central Polokwane for routine banking. It forms part of the bank's wider branch network and trades from Shop 11 inside the shopping centre, serving shoppers who pass through on weekdays and over weekends. The cashless format suits customers who are comfortable banking by card or electronically rather than over a counter.

Telkom Direct Mall of the North (Polokwane) is a Telkom-branded telecommunications retail store trading from Shop L51 inside Mall of the North in Bendor. As a Telkom Direct outlet, the store covers the operator's own telecommunications business directly, spanning mobile and fixed-line connections, broadband and internet services, and a range of devices and accessories, rather than operating as an independent reseller.

The store serves both consumer and business customers across Polokwane who need help with Telkom contracts, connectivity or devices, backed by the reach of South Africa's long-established telecommunications operator. Trading inside Mall of the North alongside the centre's other stores, it follows the mall's weekday and weekend trading hours, making it a convenient stop for anyone combining a Telkom visit with a regular shopping trip to the mall.

items.description:
The Polygraph Professionals CC is a polygraph testing service based at 94 Jones Street in Capricorn, Polokwane. The company says it has conducted more than 8,500 forensic, crime-related and personnel vetting examinations. Its services include pre-employment screening, periodic staff honesty audits, forensic investigations and dispute-resolution tests.

A polygraph records changes in heart rate, blood pressure, breathing and skin activity while the person answers specific questions, and the company explains this process on its website. The business operates across North Gauteng, the North West, Mpumalanga and Limpopo, including Polokwane, and it serves clients who need examinations for workplace or investigation matters.

The Queen Pet Shop in Thornhill is a pet supply store inside Thornhill Shopping Centre, stocking food and accessories for dogs, cats, small animals, reptiles, birds and fish. The dog range covers dry and wet food, treats, toys, beds, collars, leads and harnesses, as well as grooming and hygiene products and medication and supplements. Cat owners can choose dry and wet food and treats.

The chain's website highlights vet-recommended nutrition brands such as Hill's Science Plan, and the store is a convenient stop for owners who want food, accessories and supplies in one trip. It also serves customers with small animals, reptiles, birds and fish, which makes it useful for households with more than one kind of pet. The shop is on the corner of Veldspaat and Munnik Avenue in Thornhill.

TOPS at SPAR Lebowakgomo is the liquor outlet attached to the SuperSpar at Shop 23 in Mall@Lebo, on the corner of the R518 and R579 roads in Lebowakgomo. It stocks a wide range of beer, wine and spirits alongside other alcoholic beverages, giving SuperSpar shoppers a dedicated liquor counter to visit as part of the same trip.

The store serves retail customers across Lebowakgomo who are doing their everyday grocery shopping at SuperSpar and want to pick up drinks for home or for an event at the same time. Trading from inside Mall@Lebo, it keeps long hours through the week and over weekends, including Sunday trade, which suits shoppers who need a liquor store open outside standard weekday business hours.

Torga Optical has traded from Shop 29 at Limpopo Mall on Market Street in Polokwane Central since December 1998. The practice offers eye examinations, spectacles and contact lenses, with a resident optometrist and eyewear consultants on the team. Customers can choose from more than 800 Torga frames, many of which the company designs and makes itself.

The company says its lenses are made in its own lab using German precision technology, and it sells Easivue daily and monthly contact lenses. The store also offers retinal imaging and a free visual screening, and it accepts most medical aids through a digital claims system. Customers can book an eye test online, by phone or by email, and walk-in clients are welcome.

Truworths Seshego is the Truworths fashion store at Shop 22 inside Seshego Circle, on Ditlou Street in Seshego. Rather than a stand-alone boutique, it operates as one of the shopping centre's anchor fashion tenants, stocking the chain's trend-led clothing, footwear and accessories ranges for both women and men, together with dedicated lingerie and formalwear sections.

Shoppers in Seshego can cover everyday wear through to smarter occasion pieces, such as suits and dresses, without travelling into central Polokwane for a full clothing range. The branch suits customers who want current fashion trends alongside more formal options in one visit, and its position inside Seshego Circle makes it an easy stop to combine with the rest of a shopping trip to the centre.

Tsebang Chartered Accountants & Auditors is a chartered accounting firm at Unit A, Mirome Place, 16 Dimitri Crescent, in Bendor, Polokwane. The firm provides accounting, audit, taxation and business advisory services to businesses, individuals, trusts and non-profit organisations. It describes its work as accounting for, verifying and reporting on business finances.

Quality assurance is a stated focus, and the firm says it aims to keep clients satisfied over a long professional relationship. It describes itself as reliable, accountable and responsive, and it invites prospective clients to get in touch to discuss their requirements. Its website includes pages on the team and the services offered, which helps anyone comparing accounting firms in the area.

Vleislapa Marshall Street is a butchery at 222 Marshall Street in Polokwane, selling fresh meat and other butchery products to shoppers in the Flora Park area. The shop has built up a steady base of customer reviews on local business-listing platforms, a sign of regular repeat trade from the surrounding neighbourhood.

Customers can visit the shop for fresh cuts and other butchery items for everyday cooking or for stocking up ahead of a braai, with the business reachable directly for orders and queries. It trades from Monday to Friday and is closed over weekends, giving regular customers a fixed weekday routine for collecting their meat, and making it one of the area's everyday neighbourhood shopping stops.

Alpha Nursery, also known locally as Bretsini Nursery, is a plant nursery and landscaping business trading from Plot 35 on De Wet Drive in Bendor Park. Alongside its plant stock, the business offers a wide range of garden services, including landscape design, garden paving, lawn edging, irrigation installation, tree felling and pruning, weed control, and general garden and plant maintenance.

The business has built up a strong base of customer reviews through local service directories, reflecting steady demand from gardeners and homeowners in the area. It serves customers across Bendor and the wider Polokwane area who are shopping for plants and gardening products, as well as those looking for a single business to design, plant and maintain a garden from start to finish.

Bargain Books Mall of the North is the Bargain Books branch inside Mall of the North in Bendor, part of a national chain of close to 90 stores across South Africa. The store carries books across a wide range of categories, from children's titles to general fiction and non-fiction, giving readers in Polokwane an affordable place to browse and buy.

Shoppers can browse the shelves in person at the Bendor store and collect orders placed through the chain's own website, combining in-store browsing with online convenience. Trading from inside Mall of the North, the branch serves general book buyers and families across Bendor and the wider Polokwane area who want a straightforward, affordable bookshop as part of a regular visit to the mall.

C D Roof Trusses, registered as Malephuma Trading Roof, is a timber roof truss manufacturer trading from Plot 4 in Myngenoegen, Polokwane. It is listed as an approved manufacturer within the MiTek network, which engineers the connector-plate roof truss systems used in local construction, giving the business access to engineered roofing materials rather than basic timber framing alone.

The business supplies roofing materials and ready-made truss structures to builders and property owners around Polokwane, supporting construction projects that call for engineered roof structures rather than off-the-shelf timber. Trading from its Myngenoegen premises, it serves customers across the wider Polokwane area who need roofing materials and truss supply from a locally based, MiTek-affiliated manufacturer.

Capitec Bank Limpopo Mall trades locally as Capitec Bank Polokwane Middestad Mall, from Shop 16 on Market Street inside the mall in Polokwane Central. As a full Capitec branch, it offers the bank's everyday banking services, including its Global One transaction and savings account, personal loans and fixed deposit investments, all managed through the one account.

The branch gives Capitec customers in central Polokwane a convenient place to open accounts, manage savings or apply for credit while they are already at the mall for other shopping. It keeps standard banking hours through the working week and trades on Saturday mornings too, closing on Sundays, which suits shoppers who prefer to handle their banking during a weekend visit to the mall.

items.description:
CARtime Nirvana is a car service and repair workshop in Nirvana, Polokwane, part of the national CARtime network that has provided car service and repairs since 1999. The workshop offers bakkie and car servicing, major services, repairs, maintenance and electronic diagnostics, along with suspension, brake and clutch repairs. Customers can book a service through the branch page.

The company says its service advisors and mechanics are highly trained and focused on a stress-free customer experience. Its stated mission is to provide quality vehicle service at affordable prices, and its site also lists a right-to-repair service. Drivers in Nirvana who want regular servicing or repairs for a bakkie or car can use the workshop on Gypsum Street.

Dental 360 is a general dental practice in Shop 33A at Paledi Mall in Mankweng, Polokwane. The practice offers general, aesthetic and specialised dentistry, and it says its clinic is clean, spacious and accommodating. Patients can book online or call the practice to arrange a visit.

The practice says it believes everyone deserves quality dentistry at an affordable price, and it lists affordable fees as part of its offer. Digital technology is used to make the practice more efficient, and the team can speak six official South African languages between them, so patients can be helped in their home language. The practice aims to take dentistry to the people who need it most.

Food Lover's Market The Farmyard is a supermarket inside The Farmyard Trading Post in Bendor, Polokwane, part of the national Food Lover's Market chain. The store has a bakery, butchery, deli, fishmonger and sushi counter, alongside fresh produce and everyday groceries. Wine is also sold, and there is parking for shoppers.

The Farmyard Trading Post sits at the corner of Munnik and School Street, so shoppers can combine a visit to the store with other stops in the centre. The store page also lets customers sign up for the specials available at the branch. The supermarket suits households who want fresh meat, seafood and sushi as well as everyday groceries in one place.

Hennie's Thornhill is the Thornhill Shopping Centre branch of the Hennie's grill and pub chain, offering casual pub dining and big-screen sports viewing in Polokwane. The menu covers food and drinks, and the branch runs regular events, including quiz nights. Its address is on Veldspaat Street inside the Thornhill Shopping Centre.

The branch is cashless and adds a 10% service fee to bills, so guests should plan for that. It accepts bookings from Monday to Thursday, although bookings can be restricted on Saturdays during big sporting events, and the team asks guests to call ahead to confirm. Its site also lists the chain's drinks and food menus, along with specials and promotions.

Intercare Polokwane is a combined medical and dental centre in Shop 28 at The Greenery on Oost Street in Polokwane Central. The centre offers general practitioner and dental services, and the wider Intercare group describes its care as running from pathology to preventative care. Walk-in consultations are welcome, and patients can also book online.

The centre is a cashless facility that accepts card payments only, so patients should plan their payment in advance. Its location inside The Greenery makes it easy to combine a visit with shopping in the centre. Patients who prefer to plan ahead can book through the group's website, while walk-ins are also seen at the practice.

J's Cleaning is a home and office cleaning service based in Moregloed, Polokwane, which also supplies cleaning chemicals and equipment. The company uses SABS-approved chemicals and makes material safety data sheets available for its products. Its cleaning services can be customised to each client's needs, covering homes, offices and other areas.

The shop sells a full range of cleaning equipment and paper products, plus household, industrial and healthcare-approved chemicals. Free local delivery is offered within the Polokwane area, and the company accepts returns and refunds where a customer is not fully satisfied with a product, subject to its terms. Customers can request a free quote through the contact page.

Letlotlo Primary School is a public primary school at 1913 Zone 1 in Seshego, Polokwane, serving around 725 learners with a staff of 16 teachers. The school is a no-fee school and a Section 21 self-reliant school, which means its governing body manages part of its own budget. It carries a national EMIS number and is recorded in the urban part of the Capricorn District.

The school is classified as Quintile 3 in its profile, which helps parents understand how government funding is allocated to it. Families looking for a public primary school in Seshego can compare its learner numbers and staffing with other local schools before applying. The school serves the Zone 1 community in Seshego, in Limpopo.

Limpopo Toyota is a Toyota dealership on the corner of Munnik Avenue and Veldspaat Street in Thornhill, Polokwane, part of the CFAO Mobility group. The dealership offers new and used vehicle sales, servicing, parts and finance. Its online showroom lists about 66 vehicles, with SUVs, hatchbacks and double-cab bakkies among the most common body types.

The group's listing names Toyota, Suzuki and Volkswagen as its popular brands, which gives buyers a choice beyond Toyota alone. Customers who want to browse stock online can use the dealership's virtual showroom page, and the sales team can be reached by phone. The Thornhill location is convenient for drivers in the Thornhill Estate area.

Limpopo Wedding Planner is a wedding planning and coordination service based at 152 Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, serving couples across Limpopo. The team designs and delivers weddings whether the celebration is at home in a rural village or at a five-star venue. Services run from venue selection through to the logistics on the wedding day.

The planner works in partnership with couples, sharing advice and experience so that the planning process is less stressful. The website offers a 90-day planner and answers common questions, including what a planner includes and how a planner works alongside a venue's own co-ordinator. The service aims to keep every detail in line with the couple's own style and personality.

Masai Lodge is a guesthouse at 44 Langenhoven Street in Ivy Park, Polokwane, offering en-suite double rooms with DSTV and air conditioning. The lodge has an on-site restaurant and bar that serves breakfast, and guests can book their stay through the website. It is close to the Polokwane Game Reserve, which makes it a useful base for visitors exploring the area.

The lodge caters for business and leisure guests, and the website lists its accommodation options, facilities and restaurant menu. Guests can contact the team by email or phone to arrange a stay. The property presents itself as a stop-over or getaway destination in the capital, with modern facilities and comfortable rooms.

Modiri Health Polokwane is an occupational health clinic at 42 Railway Street in Annadale, Polokwane. It provides pre-employment medicals, chest X-rays, drug and alcohol testing and psychological fitness evaluations for workplace compliance. The clinic describes its pre-medical screening as a preliminary mini-medical assessment that includes vital checks and drug testing.

Alongside occupational health, the clinic offers primary care, and the group runs a mobile clinic and workplace campaigns. It also has a branch in Mokopane, while the Polokwane team focuses on helping employers meet health and safety regulations. Companies that need workforce assessments can get in touch through the contact details on the website.
